_comment: Per-client config — this is what makes the sweep plug-and-play. Copy to client.json (gitignored) per client; the workflow reads identity + destination + which sources to run from here, so onboarding a new client never means editing daily-open-items.md. Source at run time: CLIENT_CONFIG_JSON env secret, else client.json. Credentials live in the matching email/slack/attio configs (or *_JSON env secrets).
